definition34.document: Nghị quyết 252/2025/QH15 (Quốc hội, sửa đổi, bổ sung một số điều của Nghị quyết 81/2023/QH15), Điều 3 khoản 1 điểm a — reorganizes the 6 socio-economic regions to match the 34 post-merger provincial units; implemented earlier at Government level by Nghị quyết 306/NQ-CP (Chính phủ, 05/10/2025, điều chỉnh Quy hoạch tổng thể quốc gia)
definition34.note: IMPORTANT — this is NOT a same-boundary relabelling of the six definition63 regions onto 34 units. It is a genuine reorganization of the regions themselves: 'Tây Nguyên' (Central Highlands) no longer exists as a standalone region — it is merged with the southern part of the old 'Bắc Trung Bộ và duyên hải miền Trung' into a new 'Duyên hải Nam Trung Bộ và Tây Nguyên' (South Central Coast and Central Highlands) region (6 units); the old 'Bắc Trung Bộ và duyên hải miền Trung' region is split, leaving a smaller standalone 'Bắc Trung Bộ' (5 units); 'Đông Nam Bộ' shrinks from 6 old provinces to 3 merged units (Hồ Chí Minh, Đồng Nai, Tây Ninh — each of which absorbed neighboring old-Đông Nam Bộ provinces); 'Trung du và miền núi phía Bắc' and 'Đồng bằng sông Hồng' keep their names but with 9 and 6 units respectively. Because the NDC-SDG linkage and National Adaptation Plan datasets use the OLD (definition63) region names and boundaries (e.g. a standalone 'Central Highlands', a standalone 'South East'), this new 6-region scheme is recorded here for completeness (it does answer 'is there an official post-2025 definition' — yes) but is NOT used to populate units34[].regions/status below. units34[] instead reports each unit's status against definition63 boundaries, which is what determines whether a 34-unit province can be safely highlighted under one dataset region name or spans more than one.

units34MethodologyNote: Because definition34's official region boundaries differ structurally from definition63 (see note above) and the target datasets (NDC-SDG linkage, NAP) use definition63-era region names, each unit34 below is classified as 'single' or 'mixed' by checking whether all of its memberAdm1Codes (63-era provinces) fall inside the same single definition63 region (regions[].key), per the task's fallback rule for when a dataset-relevant official redefinition is not directly usable. 'regions' lists the definition63 key(s) actually touched.
unconfirmed: The single canonical English name for 'Bắc Trung Bộ và duyên hải miền Trung' is not pinned to one Government style-guide source; multiple equally-official-looking English renderings exist ('North Central and Central Coastal Region', 'The North and South Central Coast'). Vietnamese name and 63-province membership are solid; only the preferred English label string is soft.

vanban.chinhphu.vn's own page for Nghị quyết 81/2023/QH15 (docid=207352) and for Nghị quyết 252/2025/QH15 (docid=216616) render as a document-metadata/PDF-viewer page under WebFetch and could not be scraped for full body text directly; province lists were cross-confirmed via independent secondary sources (thuvienphapluat.vn document-numbered summaries, luatvietnam.vn article-numbered translations) that agree verbatim with each other and sum to the correct totals (63 and 34), but the primary PDF text itself was not read character-by-character.

Direct fetch of nso.gov.vn's Q1-2026 and Q4/2025 socio-economic reports failed twice with ECONNRESET; the claim that NSO's current six statistical regions match definition63 (rather than the older 8-region GSO breakdown) rests on a search-result snippet, not a full document read.

Nghị quyết 306/NQ-CP (Chính phủ, 05/10/2025) and Nghị quyết 252/2025/QH15 (Quốc hội, per search result dated 10/12/2025) both redefine the same 34-unit six-region scheme; it was not independently verified whether 252/2025/QH15's Điều 3 khoản 1 điểm a is a verbatim re-enactment of 306/NQ-CP's appendix or introduces additional wording differences, since neither was read as full primary text (both accessed via luatvietnam.vn's article-level summaries).
